Key Points: Origin, history, and ownership trail of data or artifacts; critical for trust and quality assessment.
Provenance ensures reproducibility, transparency, and attribution in scientific research.
W3C PROV models (PROV-DM, PROV-O, PROV-N, etc.) help structure provenance data; supports querying and reasoning.
Applicable in cosmology, genealogy, stratigraphy, phylogeny, and climate science.
Used in projects like DataONE, climate assessment, and maize agriculture modeling.
YesWorkflow (YW) supports script-based workflow annotation; noWorkflow (NW) captures Python runtime traces.
Visual workflow views (process, data, combined) generated for insight and communication.
YW uses @BEGIN, @END, @IN, @OUT annotations to capture conceptual structure of scripts.
Provenance queries can trace data lineage, identify input-output relationships, and integrate with runtime artifacts.
